about:
# Second Wind

Second Wind gives you a debrief after a close call or death in World of
Warcraft. Once the fight is over, it shows the hits that hurt most, how
your health fell, and which potions or abilities were ready but went unused.
After a few debriefs, you can compare what your dangerous fights have in
common.

For Classic Era, Hardcore, Season of Discovery and World of
Warcraft: Forever, in English and French. Nothing pops up
during combat. Duels and battlegrounds are excluded.

Get it from [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1739380),
[Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/XKqEjbKy) or
[GitHub releases](https://github.com/salty-max/second-wind/releases).
One download covers all of them.

## In game

Type `/secondwind` or `/wind`, or click the minimap button to open the book.
By default, surviving below 15% health counts as a close call. The threshold
can also be set to 10%, 20% or 25%.

The **Debriefs** tab shows individual fights, with a health graph, foes,
large hits, healing, stuns and fears, and the tools you used or left ready.
**Patterns** compares close calls after your third debrief. **Lifelines**
shows the emergency supplies you carry now and their cooldowns.

Debriefs are saved across your account, separately for each game. A fallen
Hardcore character's last fight remains available from your next character.
An optional word before a pull gives, in chat, the counts of your close calls
against foes like the one you target.

Forever limits the health and combat information addons can read. Second
Wind reconstructs health estimates from damage, healing and the game's
low-health warning or death recap. That warning must stay on
(**Options > Combat**). The debrief shows when a health value is an estimate.

Second Wind reads in English and French. Other clients get English, with the game's own names for your foes, spells,
items and places in their language. Debriefs keep them by the game's ids, so
they follow your client's language, even after you switch.

The settings also offer the book's size (four steps) and paper colours (dark ink on tan paper, applied by a
reload: the page ends with a Reload button). **Options > Key Bindings** lists **Open Second Wind**: one key,
or on Forever a controller button, opens and closes the book. Nothing is bound until you choose.

- `/wind copy` opens a text version of the debrief for you to copy.
- `/wind lifelines` opens the Lifelines tab.
- `/wind probe` reports what the game let the addon read after your next fight.
- `/wind settings` opens settings for thresholds, alerts and the word before a pull.
- `/wind welcome` reopens the welcome page.
- `/wind minimap` shows or hides the minimap button.
- `/wind export` and `/wind import CODE` transfer settings.
- `/wind reset` clears this character's debriefs after confirmation.

Second Wind shares its book style with the other addons of the family. Each
works independently, and Keyring can gather their minimap buttons behind one button.

The full store description is in [addon/CURSEFORGE.md](https://github.com/salty-max/second-wind/blob/main/addon/CURSEFORGE.md).
[docs/forever.md](https://github.com/salty-max/second-wind/blob/main/docs/forever.md) records what Forever lets an addon see.

## Development

```bash
bun run check      # Translations, Lua, game and locale simulations, TOCs
bun run locales    # Write addon/SecondWind/Text_<locale>.lua from i18n/
bun run creatures  # Write the creatures' portraits from wow-data's databases
bun run package    # Create dist/SecondWind-<version>.zip
scripts/release.sh --version X.Y.Z [--hold] NOTES.md
```

The release script tags and pushes. GitHub Actions publishes the addon on
GitHub, CurseForge and Wago. The shared kit is copied to
`addon/SecondWind/Kit.lua` from `../addon-kit`.

releases.notes:
Second Wind 0.7.0

- New: **Book size** makes the whole window larger, in four steps from Normal to Largest, and **Paper colours** show dark ink on tan paper instead of the dark look. Both are in the settings. Paper colours apply after a reload, and the settings page now ends with a Reload button and a line saying so.
- New: a key binding. **Options > Key Bindings** lists **Open Second Wind** under a heading of its own, so one key, or on Forever a controller button, opens and closes the book. Nothing is bound until you choose.
- On Forever, the window now tells the Gamepad UI that it is open, so a controller's D-pad can move across its buttons.
- On Forever with the Gamepad UI on, the game can show its blocked-action popup after an options page opens. That is a bug in the game's own Gamepad UI. A reload clears it, and the settings page now says so.
- The game's data is brought up to date.

A fix for Forever's launch.

- A fight no longer risks an error at its start when the game hides the kind of a debuff.

Second Wind 0.6.0

- Debriefs read better: the joins between phrases are cleaner, a place is never shown as a "?", and a boss is named a boss before a pull.
- Items are named the way each game's client names them.
- French is finished: control lost, bosses and rare elites, grammar the templates caused, and the client's spacing.
- The interface is in English and French. German and Spanish stay English for now.

The family's look, second and third pass
- The debriefs sit on the family's book and page, and the window has the books' size and is kept where you left it.
- The card and the pages fill the wider window, with no empty margin on the right.
- A death you picked in the list keeps its red row.
- The copy button is the family's, and the addon's name in chat wears the theme's accent.
- Banners stay up ten seconds, with a setting to change that.

Second Wind 0.6.0

- **A slash command and an options page** like the rest of the family, and every chat line a sentence with a capital.
- **Latin American Spanish** keeps its own names where its client has them, with Spanish from Spain filling the gaps, and Sulhasa's name no longer shows a placeholder.
- The reset line says the same thing everywhere, and the Spanish heal calculator reads naturally.
